description: Ania Studio makes YouTube videos (16:9) and Shorts/Reels (9:16) about the user’s app or any channel topic (lessons, faith, drawing…), with their own images and clips. The presenter is the user’s Ania avatar, the user themself (their own recording, background removed, their own voice) or nobody (narration + content only). Narration in pt-BR or en-US. A project is the series/channel (brand, presenter, voice, format); each episode is one video with an Ania Script (titulo + cenas). Lists the user’s projects with their episodes and the latest version of each. Free.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.
